seo.metaTitle: Base64 encoder and decoder — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Convert text to Base64 and back. Handles any language and emoji. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/dev/base64-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Base64 encoder and decoder processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/dev/base64-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does Base64 encoder and decoder upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Base64 encoder and decoder executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/dev/base64-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Base64 encoder and decoder?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/base64.json or open /tools/base64?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
